course: Course 4: Operating Systems and Embedded Linux
reviewer_type: AI review with every command and program run by content/programming/tools/run_chapter.py; no human review yet
title: How This Course Works, and Setting Up a Linux Lab
subtitle: What this course builds, how every chapter is checked, and a working Linux lab on any laptop: by the end, one C program running on two different processors.
prerequisite_note: A laptop with any operating system, and C as far as Course 3, Chapters 0 to 10.
objectives: Get a Linux system on Windows, macOS, Linux or a Chromebook.
Install gcc, QEMU and an ARM64 cross-compiler.
Cross-compile a C program for ARM64 and run it on an x86 laptop with qemu-aarch64.
Explain dynamic and static linking well enough to fix the commonest QEMU error.
Compare x86-64 and ARM64 machine code for the same function.
